RecurringPaymentService/Charge.recurring_charge: CONNECTOR_API_LACKS: doc:https://docs.datatrans.ch/docs/merchant-initiated-payments - Datatrans charges a stored card alias only together with the stored card expiry (card.expiryMonth/card.expiryYear), which RecurringPaymentService.Charge carries in additional_payment_data.card; this global scenario sends no card expiry and the scenario harness has no additional_payment_data oneof mapping to supply one, so the connector refuses the request with MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD before any call. The alias charge is exercised end to end through Hyperswitch, which sends the stored card expiry
